author: ParthDarthVader
body:
Before any of you say "post glitches here <link>", I want to say that I don't know where to post it. In other words, I forgot the link. But im also posting it here so that the Avicus community knows whats going on in OITC.

Basically, on OITC, when you die, you get teleported to a normal world. From there, people spawn kill. (Yes I admit I did spawn kill, but only 4 times.) I killed 4 people, which as you can see, the highest score Is 6. Then I somehow come in first.
